cross_tool_rules: No tool becomes correctness or merge authority.
No score threshold is promoted from the frozen fixture.
Keep tools while runner cost and operational noise do not materially interfere with primary QA.
Retirement is an explicit evidence-based decision after field operation.
Needle traces are research evidence only.

needle3.signal_domain: independent local embedding geometry and future Needle-lab field trace
needle3.trace_value: preserve source/model/candidate/task provenance for future theseus-needle-lab analytics

semble.output_semantics: ranked advisory top-k with provenance; score is not confidence
semble.signal_domain: ranked retrieval over previously learned failure classes

semdup.r8_constraint: cache or prebuild the exact binary/toolchain path before routine PR use
